description:
For distinct \(p,q,r\), setting the units \(p,q,r\) in \([(p),(
eg p\lor q),(
eg q\lor r),(
eg r)]\) successively yields the stated residual lists and finally the empty clause; the original CNF is unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unit_trace.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p q r : α) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r)
  (hqr : q ≠ r) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unitExample p q r) =
      [[{ atom := q, positive := true }], [{ atom := q, positive := false }, { atom := r, positive := true }],
        [{ atom := r, positive := false }]] ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting q true
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unitExample p q r)) =
        [[{ atom := r, positive := true }], [{ atom := r, positive := false }]] ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting r true
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting q true
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p true
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unitExample p q r))) =
          [[]] ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.UnitChain
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unitExample p q r)
            [{ atom := p, positive := true }, { atom := q, positive := true }, { atom := r, positive := true }] ∧
          ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Sat (Lemmatheca.Entry.DpllSatisfiability.unitExample p q r)
